title: Vendedor externo - Advisory
description:
Quem somos nós:

A Skintec é uma empresa referência em tecnologias para medicina estética e bem-estar, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado . Atuamos ao lado de médicos e clínicas que buscam inovação, segurança e resultados consistentes, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas de alto padrão, respaldadas por evidências científicas e certificações internacionais.

Mais do que tecnologia, entregamos suporte especializado, relacionamento de longo prazo e desenvolvimento para nossos parceiros . Nosso time é movido pela Cultura WOW , que valoriza pessoas, excelência e a superação de expectativas.

Skintec — conectando tecnologia, pessoas e excelência médica.


Resumo do desafio:

Realizar venda consultiva, desenvolvendo negócios e gestão de contas, prospectar e realizar a

gestão de carteira de clientes da Skintec, foco em Medical e clientes chave de cada região.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em mercado de luxo e clientes de alto padrão;
  • Vivência anterior com Medical Devices ou corretatos;
  • Forte atuação em negociações de alto ticket e vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidades com CRM.



Condições:

Contratação PJ, estamos trabalhando com pretensões salarias e condições compatíveis do mercado.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Hands‑on AWS operations (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Azure operations experience (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB).
  • Strong troubleshooting & incident management (cloud, on‑prem, Linux/Windows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM, CDK).
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash).


And much better if you stand out for:

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies beyond basics (Docker + Kubernetes in production).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (routing, load balancing, security).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows focused on reliability, patching, backup & DR.
  • Ability to create and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Prior participation in on-call rotations and leading post‑incident reviews.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary) cloud environments.
  • Handle tickets, incidents, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
  • Maintain core AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, security, and Kubernetes.
  • Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks.
  • Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS).
  • Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR.


Key Words:

  • AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Azure (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB)
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM)
  • Scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Hybrid Cloud (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS)
  • Incident Management & Troubleshooting
  • CI/CD & DevOps
  • Monitoring & Performance Optimization

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. title: Preparador de Casos de Imigração Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando um Senior Immigration Document Preparer com experiência comprovada em casos humanitários como VISTO T, VISTO U, VAWA e processos em COURT AMERICANA .

Essa posição é para profissionais que já trabalham com imigração , entendem a estrutura dos casos e conseguem preparar processos com alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Se você ainda está aprendendo ou nunca trabalhou diretamente com esses tipos de caso, essa vaga não é para você.

Responsabilidades

• Preparação completa de casos de imigração

• Organização e revisão de documentos

• Montagem de pacotes de aplicação

• Suporte à equipe jurídica

• Controle de prazos e deadlines

• Garantir consistência e precisão nos processos


Casos com os quais você irá trabalhar

• T Visa

• U Visa

• VAWA

• Asylum

• Immigration Court cases


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência REAL com imigração americana

• Experiência direta com T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, Asylum ou Court (Sabe o que são?)

• Perfil extremamente organizado e atento a detalhes

• Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e grande volume de documentos

• Profissional proativo e focado em solução de problemas


Diferenciais

• Experiência prévia em law firm de imigração

• Conhecimento de processos em Immigration Court

• Experiência preparando casos humanitários complexos


Formato

Remote (Home Office)


Remuneração

Entre R$2.000 a R$6.000

(de acordo com experiência e performance)


Importante

Para se candidatar, inclua na aplicação:

1️⃣ Quantos anos você trabalha com imigração

2️⃣ Quais desses casos você já preparou:

T Visa / U Visa / VAWA / Asylum / Court

3️⃣ Em qual escritório ou empresa você adquiriu essa experiência

Aplicações sem essas informações serão desconsideradas automaticamente.

title: Junior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks / Python / Spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing data processing, and supporting cloud-based data platforms in an Azure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory
  • Build and optimize Apache Spark jobs for large-scale data processing
  • Work with Python and SQL to transform and analyze data
  • Support data architecture using Delta Lake and Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to deliver reliable data solutions

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of Data Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • Experience building ETL pipelines
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory and cloud data platforms

Nice to have: Azure certifications, streaming data experience, or infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

description:

title: Analista de Devops Sr
description:
Com o que você irá atuar:


  • Administrar ambientes em nuvem (principalmente AWS), garantindo performance, disponibilidade e segurança
  • Automatizar processos com ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou AWS CDK
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD integradas à infraestrutura
  • Monitorar recursos de cloud usando CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana ou similares
  • Gerenciar recursos como EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB, Route53, entre outros
  • Suportar o time de desenvolvimento em deploys, testes e troubleshooting de infraestrutura
  • Apoiar na definição e implementação de políticas de segurança, backup e governança em cloud
  • Participar de projetos de migração, modernização e otimização de workloads para nuvem
  • Integrar práticas de segurança no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software
  • Interagir com as equipes de desenvolvimento para implementar controles nas plataformas Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Automatizar testes e integrar ferramentas no pipeline de CI/CD.
  • Gerenciar e monitorar a configuração das infraestruturas em nuvem e on-premise.



O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência prática com serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em automação de ambientes e CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Noções de redes, segurança em cloud e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Habilidade com sistemas Linux e scripts (bash, python, etc.)
  • Experiência com práticas em ambientes de desenvolvimento com Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em configuração de servidores Web com IIS, Nginx e Apache.



O que oferecemos como benefícios:


  • VR
  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Gympass

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

title: Archer System Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).
  • Azure – conhecimento desejável .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos de sistemas, redes e comunicação.
  • Vivência com upgrades, versionamento e rotinas de manutenção.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas corporativas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.

  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Senior Mineral Resources Consultant
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Somos uma consultoria especializada em Recursos Minerais e Inteligência Artificial aplicada à mineração .

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.
  • Work together with backend/API developers and other mobile engineers to maintain a scalable, reliable, and well‑structured app ecosystem.
  • Continuously explore new iOS technologies and propose improvements to enhance product quality and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, refine development processes, and contribute to technical decision‑making.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, and collaboration practices within the engineering team.
  • Stay current with iOS platform changes and apply best practices to ongoing development.

Mandatory Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of iOS development experience using Swift .
  • Minimum 1 year of hands‑on development using SwiftUI .
  • Deep understanding of modern iOS features and platform best practices.
  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD platforms such as Bitrise or Jenkins.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Motivated to work in a team‑based product environment.
  • Strong sense of UX, attention to detail, and focus on usability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling, debugging, and optimization on iOS.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

title: AI Engineer
description:
Must Haves

  • 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes
  • Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems
  • Strong communication skills; able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team
  • Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practices

Plusses

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies
  • Experience with Airflow
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures


Day to Day

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Responsibilities span the full lifecycle, including content ingestion and pipeline development, indexing and retrieval quality improvements, answer generation, and system evaluation. You will work on experimentation, model development, ETL workflows, search relevance, and evaluation frameworks. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

title: Desenvolvedor PHP Pleno
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ


Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Analista de Implementação - SAAS (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implementação - SAAS (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica;
  • Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana;
  • Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência;
  • Participar de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros;
  • Abertura de demandas técnicas para os times internos;
  • Apoiar na instalação da solução e nas atualizações dos ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e com acompanhamento do time mais experiente;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar implementação de projetos, garantindo histórico claro, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com os clientes durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, informando status, próximos passos e orientações.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional;
  • Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes;
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed


ITC Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Kofax Developer (French Speaker) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 3+ years with Kofax;
  • Experience with Kofax TotalAgility (KTA) and Kofax Insight (certified if possible);
  • English: B2 (spoken and written);
  • French: B2 (spoken and written);
  • Willing to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid in Lisbon after the work visa is completed.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior Azure DevOps Infrastructure Engineer


High-Traffic Drupal | Azure Web Apps | US Client (EST)


Long-term Contract | Remote (EST Hours) | Rate DOE


The Mission

Stabilize and optimize a production Drupal site on Azure Web Apps facing deployment failures and performance bottlenecks. Partner with their Senior Drupal dev to own all Azure infrastructure + DevOps . Immediate impact required , no ramp-up time.


Experience Needed

  • 5+ years Azure infrastructure/DevOps
  • 2+ years production Azure Web App Services hosting high-traffic Drupal CMS (100k+ users)
  • Proven track record of blue-green deployments rescuing troubled web applications


Must-Have Skills

  • Production Azure Web Apps (Bitbucket syncs, Oryx builds, deployment slots)
  • Drupal operations (drush rsync, updb/cim against production DBs)
  • Azure Database management (snapshots, point-in-time restores)
  • Performance optimization (maintenance mode, Redis cache management)
  • Blue-green deployment execution (smoke tests, log analysis, zero-downtime swaps)


Bonus Points

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • Drupal/Drush hands-on (config management, module deployments)
  • High-traffic optimization (sub-2s page loads under load)


Why This Role

  • 40hr/wk EST working with US consultancy (public/private/federal sectors)
  • Long-term contract with proven follow-on project pipeline
  • Single point of failure rescue → become their go-to Azure/Drupal partner

description:

Como será o seu desafio?


  • Traduzir grande volume de dados operacionais em insights claros e direcionamentos estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade operacional e grande escala, com centenas de restaurantes e múltiplas alavancas de performance.
  • Influenciar e mobilizar diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir execução efetiva das iniciativas de melhoria.

  • Local de trabalho: Bairro Butantã, próximo ao metrô

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.
