description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor Senior Front-end React.js para atuar em uma squad ágil orientada a fluxo (Kanban), responsável por construir e evoluir produtos digitais de alto impacto. O profissional trabalhará em parceria com Product Owner, UX/UI, back-end, QA e demais papéis do time, entregando para clientes internos e externos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com React.js (hooks, context, roteamento, estado, lifecycle).
  • Domínio de JavaScript ES6+ e TypeScript.
  • Familiaridade com Redux, Zustand, Recoil ou outros gestores de estado.
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Styled Components, CSS-in-JS.
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST ou GraphQL.
  • Ferramentas de build e empacotamento (Vite, Webpack, Babel).
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress ou equivalentes.
  • Git, versionamento moderno e Git Flow (ou trunk-based com PRs).
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes ágeis (Kanban, Lean, Agile mindset).


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, performáticas e responsivas utilizando React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript e o ecossistema associado.
  • Trabalhar em uma flow-based system com práticas de Kanban, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do fluxo de trabalho (WIP, lead time, cycle time, throughput, CFD).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do time, como refinamentos, dailys, análises de fluxo e retrospectivas focadas em otimização de processo.
  • Colaborar com UX/UI para transformar protótipos e conceitos em experiências reais.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs e serviços back-end, garantindo padronização e qualidade técnica.
  • Realizar code reviews, apoiar na evolução da arquitetura front-end e garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Criar e manter testes (unitários, integração e E2E) para assegurar confiabilidade e estabilidade.
  • Atuar com mentalidade de ownership do produto, entendendo o impacto das entregas no negócio.
  • Colaborar com o Chapter de Front-end e Guildas técnicas, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Job Title: Java Developer

Location: Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica

Work Mode: Remote

Employment Type: Contract


Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to join a dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java 8+ , relevant frameworks (Spring, Hibernate ), relational databases, RESTful APIs, version control, and basic frontend knowledge. This role requires problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java 8+ and frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
  • Work with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL , and write optimized queries.
  • Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Use version control tools like Git for collaboration and code management.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React .
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications.
  • Work with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence for task and project tracking.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and a dynamic work environment.
  • Communicate effectively with teams and stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Java 8+ and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, etc. )
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and web services
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React )
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly in a dynamic environment


Desirable Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Strong collaboration in cross-functional and remote teams


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in a relevant field
  • Technical certifications related to Java development are highly recommended

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: DevOps Engineer (Spanish and Portuguese Speaking)
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Manter e desenvolver a infraestrutura em nuvem da AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, etc.).
  • Garantir as práticas de observabilidade (monitoramento, alertas e logs) utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana e CloudWatch.
  • Manter e desenvolver os pipelines de CI/CD no Bitbucket para aplicações em contêineres .NET, Python e Docker.
  • Apoiar e melhorar os processos de automação de testes (integração, regressão e desempenho).
  • Implementar estratégias de segurança na nuvem (IAM, roles, compliance, hardening).
  • Apoiar a equipe de engenharia no diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes críticos.
  • Propor melhorias de arquitetura, automação e governança na nuvem.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de engenharia e qualidade para garantir entregas rápidas e seguras.


Requisitos:
  • Experiência em ambientes com ASP.NET.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência trabalhando com AWS, utilizando serviços como EKS, ECS + Fargate, SQL Server + RDS, SQS, EC2, VPN, VPC, Transit Gateway, NAT Gateway e IAM.
  • CI/CD com Bitbucket Pipelines e integração com contêineres Docker.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou AWS CDK).
  • Experiência com Linux e automação com Shell/Bash.
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker e ECS/Fargate).
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão e qualidade: Jira (gestão ágil) e SonarQube (code quality).
  • Conhecimentos básicos de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL e/ou SQL Server).
  • Controle de versão com Git (estratégias de Git Flow).


Sobre a vaga:
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto.
  • Ambiente internacional.
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: SAP S4 HANA Finance and PTP Architect
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Skill/Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP Finance (preferably S4 HANA Finance or S4 HANA Cloud)
  • S4 HANA Finance implementation experience – In General Ledger, Intercompany, AR, AP, FA, Treasury for Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and potentially other countries with aggressive timelines

  • Research and document current business processes and provide process improvement recommendations to the business


Language Requirement:

Advanced English and Spanish

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor  - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor will ensure the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review junior auditors' work, and help align evaluation criteria across the team, driving continuous improvement in hiring processes.


Key Responsibilities:


- Executing complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervising and reviewing Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Leading calibration calls and standardizing criteria across the audit team.


Requirements:


- Experience: 5+ years in Quality Assurance roles

- Audit Expertise: Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions

- Leadership: Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations

- Language: Advanced proficiency in English


Desirable Skills:


- Talent Acquisition: Experience in recruitment processes

- Process Management: Experience with high-volume recruitment

- Technical Skills: Data analysis and SQL experience


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Orçamentista
description:
Orçamentista (Estimator)


Objetivo da Função

Experiência na elaboração de orçamentos técnicos em projetos de fachadas e building envelope, com foco em sistemas de ACM e Attachment System, vidro arquitetônico e soluções de fachada. O profissional atuará diretamente na análise de documentos de projeto, levantamento de quantidades e preparação de propostas competitivas para novos projetos.

Responsabilidades
  • Analisar projetos, especificações técnicas e documentos de licitação.
  • Realizar levantamento de quantidades (takeoffs) para sistemas de fachada, incluindo ACM, Vidro arquitetônico e outros sistemas de envelope.
  • Preparar orçamentos detalhados considerando materiais e custos indiretos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de projetos e compras para obter cotações de fornecedores.
  • Avaliar diferentes soluções técnicas para otimizar custos e competitividade das propostas.
  • Preparar e organizar pré-propostas comerciais e documentação de suporte.
  • Participar da revisão de escopo e alinhamento técnico com clientes e parceiros quando necessário.
  • Manter banco de dados atualizado de custos, fornecedores e referências de projetos anteriores.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como orçamentista na indústria de fachadas de mais de 5 anos , preferencialmente com sistemas de ACM, vidro arquitetônico e sistemas de fachada em geral .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Experiência com levantamento de quantidades (material takeoff).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica.
  • Inglês avançado , pois todos os documentos e projetos e reuniões são em inglês.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes técnicas e fornecedores.
  • O trabalho é 100% home-office.

title: Consultor investimentos
description:
VAGA PARA CONSULTOR DE INVESTIMENTOS, DESTINADA A PROFISSIONAIS COM CARTEIRA.


Buscamos profissionais que já possuem acima de R$ 25 milhões de carteira e que aceitem modelo de remuneração 100% variável.


Se você já é do mercado financeiro, e pensa em atuar em um modelo 100% alinhado com os interesses do cliente, podendo utilizar diversas plataformas (como BTG, XP, Ágora, Safra, C6..), recebendo um repasse atrativo, venha conversar conosco e conhecer o projeto da API CAPITAL Investimentos.


Superamos a marca de 600 Famílias e mais de R$1,1 bi sob consultoria, contamos com uma estrutura de apoio ao banker robusta, com o uso de sistemas de terceiros (consolidador) e sistemas proprietários (CRM e outros)


Responsabilidades

  • Prospeção de clientes;
  • Elaboração de planos de investimento personalizados para seus clientes, com recomendações sem conflito de interesse;
  • Acompanhar e avaliar o desempenho dos investimentos dos clientes e fazer ajustes quando necessário;
  • Estudar, estudar e estudar. Para poder entregar um trabalho diferenciado para seu cliente.
  • 3 focos principais perante carteira de clientes: Relacionamento / Wealth Planning e Alocação de ativos.

title: Consultor de Vendas (Belém - PA)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver estratégias de vendas de alto nível, alinhadas aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa e durante todo o processo de vendas;
  • Gerenciar contas-chave da empresa, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e maximizando as oportunidades de vendas;
  • Analisar o desempenho das vendas, identificando áreas de melhoria e implementando medidas corretivas;
  • Colaborar com a alta direção na definição de metas de vendas, orçamento e estratégias de crescimento de longo prazo;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo com clientes-chave, incluindo a compreensão das dinâmicas de negócios de cada cliente;
  • Analisar de Dados e Inteligência de Mercado para identificar oportunidades de vendas, rastrear o desempenho das vendas e ajustar estratégias com base em insights;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de negócios de longo prazo que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável da empresa;
  • Acompanhamento de Leds, começo, meio e fim fazendo o monitoramento diário com intuito de atender as demandas, afim de gerar, através dessas demandas mais negócios.



Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com atuação em áreas comerciais de bens de capital, dentro de empresas do ramo de equipamentos pesados de construção;
  • Formação superior nos cursos de Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Diferencial conhecer CRM;
  • Conhecimento em vendas de linha amarela, linha branca, linha agrícola.

title: OIC Engineer
description:
Job Title: OIC Engineer

Location: Remote - Brazil

Duration: 12+ Months


Skills:

  • OIC VBCS platform expertise
  • Java – Expert level
  • JavaScript – Expert Level
  • TRADACOM, EDIFACT, X12 – Expert
  • Experience with EDI Integrations on OIC is an Essential skill
  • Experience with SFTP and AS2 based EDI



Job Description

  • Analyze systems integrations and creates systems and software architecture that keep enterprise data secure and compliant.
  • Uses standards and best practices to create architectural designs and diagrams.
  • Interfaces with clients and business partners to understand the overall needs.
  • Create Integration processes using OIC technologies.
  • Build reusable code. Build efficiently upon the existing data model and quickly change gears as priorities change.
  • Maintain high service levels for clients, always on Implement security and data protection.
  • Design and implement data storage solutions.
  • Estimate work effort and assist with task breakdowns.
  • Document work via appropriate code comments as well as maintain complete and detailed diagrams of the work being done.
  • Collaborate with team in solving complex problems, while at same time work independently on assigned tasks.
  • Follow, enhance, and contribute to group coding standards and best practices around documentation, code.
  • formatting, source-control.
  • Ability to assist business users to get familiarity with OIC (error log checking, OIC dashboards, examining payloads for errors, etc).

The Skills & Role Content Specialist plays a crucial role in designing the skills, competencies, job descriptions, and hiring criteria that define how our Talent team assesses, selects, and develops high-quality professionals. You'll bring clarity and consistency to role content and frameworks.


Key Responsibilities:


- Developing and maintaining competency models, skills frameworks, and proficiency levels for Talent roles.

- Writing and updating job descriptions, including responsibilities, requirements, must-have skills, and role expectations.

- Translating role needs into clear hiring criteria, ensuring alignment with Technical and non-Technical requirements.

- Creating structured behavioral descriptors that support hiring, training, and performance evaluation.

- Mapping skills and competencies across seniority levels (Junior → Senior).

- Collaborating with Talent Acquisition, Role Architecture, Enablement, L&D, Governance, and Performance to ensure consistency and accuracy.

- Governing updates to ensure all role content remains clear, standardized, and up-to-date.

- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company:

Our client is a leading provider of org chart automation and workforce planning software that empowers HR professionals and the people leaders they support. To support our fast-growing team, we are hiring a Software Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems, helping customers succeed, and working closely with a team that cares deeply about the product and the people who use it.

In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them get the most value out of our client’s SaaS platform. You will troubleshoot issues, guide users through configuration and best practices, and partner with internal teams to improve both the product and the customer experience.

This is a hands-on role in a collaborative team where curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset are valued. If you enjoy technology, learning new systems, and turning complex problems into clear solutions for customers, you will thrive here.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support for web-based platform, helping customers resolve issues and use the product effectively
  • Work directly with customers to configure our product and guide them through best practices for importing and managing organizational data
  • Investigate and resolve support tickets with a focus on timely, thoughtful communication and a positive client experience
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex issues
  • Identify patterns in support requests and provide feedback that helps improve the product and documentation
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases and help refine support processes as the company grows


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience supporting web-based applications or SaaS platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues clearly and efficiently
  • Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts in a clear, approachable way
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and systems
  • Self-motivation and ownership in identifying problems and improving processes
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across teams to find solutions
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade e o desempenho ideal dos sistemas e serviços de produção.
  • Desenvolver e manter sistemas de monitoramento e alertas para detectar problemas de forma proativa.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas de manutenção, implantação e monitoramento.
  • Responder prontamente a incidentes de produção.
  • Realizar diagnósticos e resolver problemas para minimizar o tempo de inatividade.
  • Trabalhar na escalabilidade dos sistemas, garantindo que possam suportar o crescimento contínuo da empresa.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, QA e operações para implementar melhores práticas e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter documentação detalhada sobre processos, sistemas e incidentes para garantir o conhecimento compartilhado.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em SRE, com foco em operações de infraestrutura e confiabilidade de sistemas.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Ansible, Terraform, etc.) e tecnologias de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento profundo de sistemas operacionais, especialmente Linux.
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e log (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas complexos em sistemas distribuídos e fornecer soluções eficazes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração. Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e gerir prioridades concorrentes.


Benefícios:

Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Project Manager
description:
Data Center Project Manager


Datacenter People is working with one of the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world. Our client is a global professional services firm supporting the delivery of mission critical and data centre infrastructure projects. Acting as an owner’s representative, they provide commissioning management, project oversight and technical advisory services across complex developments.


Due to continued growth in Brazil , they are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commissioning delivery across multiple data center projects.


The Role


  • Lead the delivery of commissioning projects across mission critical data center environments.
  • Manage project delivery across commissioning levels L1–L5, overseeing client relationships, project teams and financial performance.
  • Act as the Competent Person for project safety, ensuring JHAs, toolbox talks and site safety requirements are completed.
  • Manage project schedules, resources and budgets using internal project management and planning systems.
  • Forecast resource requirements, manage billing projections and monitor project expenses.
  • Identify scope changes and manage the change order process with clients.
  • Coordinate commissioning teams including engineers, contractors, vendors and client representatives.
  • Support commissioning activities including design reviews, testing procedures, integrated systems testing (IST) and final commissioning documentation.
  • The Experience Profile
  • Strong understanding of engineering principles within mission critical environments.
  • Technical background in electrical or mechanical systems.
  • Electrical candidates should be comfortable working with three-phase AC power systems, DC systems and live electrical infrastructure.
  • Mechanical candidates should have experience with chilled water systems and commercial HVAC infrastructure.
  • Experience working within data centre commissioning or critical infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to work closely with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Experience reviewing shop drawings, submittals and preparing field reports.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Diretor(a) de Arte - Júnior
description:
Código da vaga: 58873


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em direção de arte, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • 3 anos de experiência prévia em agência de publicidade , marketing ou design.
  • Experiência comprovada com desdobramentos de mídia digital (adaptação de peças para diferentes formatos e canais).
  • Experiência com criação e desdobramento de e-mails /peças de e-mail marketing (CRM).
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator e similares) e Figma.
  • Conhecimento dos principais formatos e especificações de mídia digital (dimensões, pesos, boas práticas).
  • Domínio de composição, tipografia e tratamento de imagens, garantindo consistência visual.
  • Bom senso estético e atenção a detalhes de acabamento e padronização.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de cumprir prazos com autonomia.
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do mercado digital e de design.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa e criativa.
  • Demonstrar abertura para aprender e contribuir de forma parceira no time.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: Account Manager
description:
THIS ROLE REQUIRES RELOCATING TO TAIWAN FOR 6 MONTHS FOR MANDATORY TRAINING


Main Responsibilities:


  • Develop long-term relationships with key customers, ensuring consistent engagement and satisfaction
  • Oversee and expand revenue streams within an assigned portfolio by identifying growth opportunities
  • Collaborate with clients to improve game visibility and performance through targeted marketing and promotional activities
  • Contribute to securing and maintaining favorable commercial terms in partnerships
  • Coordinate closely with internal marketing teams to deliver high-quality and effective promotional campaigns
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by sharing insights, best practices, and industry knowledge
  • Provide prompt and efficient support to operators, ensuring all requests are handled in a timely manner


Desired experience:


  • Previous experience in account management, business development, or similar client-facing roles, ideally within iGaming, gaming, or digital entertainment (preferred but not strictly mandatory)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build lasting relationships
  • Familiarity with marketing strategies and promotional planning is advantageous
  • Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Brazilian nationality or eligibility to work in Brazil is required
  • Willingness to undergo an initial training period in Taiwan before transitioning to a role based in Brazil (mandatory)

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sr | Inglês Fluente
description:
LOUCOS POR INOVAÇÃO E TRANSFORMAÇÃO:

A .add é uma empresa de TI e inovação, com 25 anos no mercado. Estamos localizados no São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Miami. Com atuação marcante no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvemos soluções eficientes de forma singular para entregar os melhores serviços e produtos nas áreas de Inovação e Tecnologia. Nosso diferencial está na expertise de um time multidisciplinar e comprometido com as melhores práticas ágeis utilizadas para superar desafios corporativos e garantir resultados extraordinários com precisão, agilidade e segurança.

Tecnologia, Liderança, Agilidade, Inovação e Pessoas, são os pontos que formam a essência da .add.

Aqui na .add você vai encontrar:

  • Ambiente colaborativo
  • Hibrído SP;
  • Oportunidade PJ;
  • Circuito de treinamentos
  • Programa de Educação Continuada
  • Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter microserviços Java em ambientes de produção
  • Inglês avançado
  • Projetar e otimizar APIs RESTful usando Spring Boot
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e desempenho de sistemas distribuídos
  • Colaborar com arquitetos de software na definição de padrões e boas práticas
  • Conduzir code reviews e promover uma cultura de qualidade de código
  • Participar de planejamento ágil, estimativas e entregas de sprint

Requisitos :

Orquestração de APIs via iComposer (Groovy – low-code).

Orquestração de APIs via BFF ou camada do Cliente/Parceiro (Java).

Customização de Batch (Groovy – low-code).

Customização de Batch de alta complexidade (Java).

IHub / Gestão de Integrações (OPA – low-code).

Java 11 e 17

Spring Framework (Spring Batch, Spring Cloud) JPA Javascript (es6+) Micro-services e Open API (antigo swagger) JUnit( JUnit 5 ),Mockito( Mockito framework site )

SpringTest (Testing :: Spring Framework)

React (component lifecycle, setState, setState callback, props as functions, hooks)


Desejável:

Groovy ( The Apache Groovy programming language ) Docker e Kubernetes Typescript Jest (JavaScript Testing Framework) Flexbox (Flexbox - Aprendendo desenvolvimento web | MDN , Flexbox Froggy ) Modelagem de banco de dados OPA ( Open Policy Agent | Documentation ) Conhecimento de seguros;

title: Partner Success Executive - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Partner Success Executive position focuses on managing relationships with Senior Advisors - senior referral partners committed to generating leads through introductions. This role involves ensuring advisors achieve their lead goals through effective time management, process execution, and relationship building while maintaining engagement cadence, tracking performance metrics, and optimizing targeting strategies to drive high-quality introductions and conversions.


Key responsibilities


- Onboarding new Senior Advisors by establishing clear expectations around introductions, engagement cadence, and performance metrics.

- Providing ongoing support to advisors as the primary point of contact, maintaining structured 1:1 meetings to track pipeline and engagement, guiding targeting strategy and ideal prospect profiles, and monitoring performance metrics.

- Managing introductions and lead generation by qualifying prospects before engagement, connecting with introduced prospects in a timely and professional manner, managing follow-up cadence through conversion or disqualification, and handing off qualified leads to Sales Operations with proper documentation.

- Driving advisor engagement by maintaining motivation and retention, facilitating participation in advisory tasks, events, and networking initiatives, collecting structured feedback to improve program design, and ensuring positive experience and long-term program loyalty.

- Providing feedback to advisors on introduction quality and outcomes while optimizing targeting based on conversion data.

- Driving continuous improvement by proposing process enhancements where applicable.


Requirements


- Account Management Experience: 4+ years of relevant experience in Account Management or Business Development roles in similar environments.

- US Market Knowledge: 1+ year of experience working with the US market in sales, business development, or account management capacity.

- Energy and Motivation: High energy levels and self-driven motivation to achieve results.

- People Skills: Excellent interpersonal abilities and relationship-building capabilities.

- Communication Excellence: Strong selling, communication, and negotiation skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor de Suporte em SuccessFactors (GDC)
description:
Consultor de Suporte em SuccessFactors (GDC)

Data de início: imediata.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: Remoto.

Horário de Trabalho: comercial.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Suporte em SuccessFactors (GDC)SAP (GDC).


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:

• Profissional com mais de 3 anos de experiência em HRIS, atuando como usuário-chave ou como consultor.

• Ter interesse em uma ampla gama de processos de RH (do core ao talento) e em diferentes setores.

• Possuir carteira de habilitação, para poder se deslocar conforme necessário.

• Ter capacidade de comunicação em holandês e francês será considerado um diferencial.

• Proficiência avançada ou fluente no idioma inglês (fala, leitura e escrita).


Responsabilidades:

• Receber e analisar chamados, solucionando incidentes;

• Investigar a causa raiz de erros ao tratar solicitações de serviço.

• Aprofundar-se em novas funcionalidades do SAP SuccessFactors e apresentá-las ao cliente.

• Implementar novas funcionalidades para nossos clientes.

• Colaborar de forma próxima com o cliente, construindo um relacionamento sólido.

• Identificar novas oportunidades ou melhorias para nossos clientes.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Coupa Consultant (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Olá, somos a Tech Mahindra, A Tech Mahindra é uma empresa global de tecnologia e consultoria, presente em 90+ países e composta por mais de 148 mil profissionais , atendendo mais de 1.100 clientes em todo o mundo , conforme dados oficiais do LinkedIn e Mahindra Group. Parte do Mahindra Group , um dos maiores e mais admirados conglomerados globais, a companhia se destaca pelo compromisso com inovação, inclusão e impacto social, tendo sido a primeira empresa indiana a receber o Terra Carta Seal , reconhecimento internacional para organizações que lideram iniciativas em prol de um futuro climático e ambientalmente positivo.

Estamos buscando um(a) Coupa Consultant com forte conhecimento técnico e experiência prática em implementação, rollout e suporte de soluções Coupa. Essa pessoa será responsável por atuar em configurações avançadas, integrações, workflows, dados mestres e governança do sistema, garantindo alta performance e aderência às necessidades do negócio.

✨ Responsabilidades e Requisitos Técnicos

  • Sólido domínio dos módulos Coupa , com experiência em implementação e rollout.
  • Experiência hands-on configurando módulos como S2P, P2P, CLMA, SIM, CRA , incluindo: Sourcing, Contracts, Procure, Invoice, Expenses, entre outros.
  • Vivência com integrações Coupa , atuando com diversos parceiros — especialmente integração com SAP .
  • Capacidade de configurar workflows e processos , incluindo requisições, pedidos de compra (PO) e faturas, ajustando o sistema conforme os requisitos do negócio.
  • Atuação em Gerenciamento de Releases , incluindo upgrades, patches e novos recursos, garantindo transições suaves em parceria com times internos.
  • Suporte ao usuário final, com forte habilidade em troubleshooting , resolução de problemas e manutenção de documentação técnica.
  • Garantir aderência a controles internos, segurança e melhores práticas na administração do ambiente Coupa.
  • Execução de configurações e gestão de dados mestres , incluindo grupos de conteúdo, códigos de empresa, dados empresariais, plano de contas e códigos fiscais.
  • Atuação em testes unitários, UAT e suporte ao go-live .
  • Experiência com o módulo SIM , incluindo criação de formulários para onboarding de novos fornecedores e atualização de informações de fornecedores.

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto
  • Contratação CLT ou PJ

title: Senior Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Architect .


In this role you will:

Lead architecture and delivery of systems that unify OT and IT across SCADA/MES and enterprise platforms. Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), govern industrial data models, and enable secure, scalable batch/streaming integrations on‑prem and in the cloud.

  • Architect and design end‑to‑end OT→IT data integrations (batch/streaming) from SCADA, MES, Historians to enterprise/cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is a plus.

  • Integrate industrial platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ, HighByte advantageous) via OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/govern RESTful APIs and connectors for SAP, SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Define and socialize application/integration/infrastructure standards, lead architecture for enterprise IT and digital transformation in regulated manufacturing.
  • Deploy/support enterprise applications with reliability, compliance, and operability, design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Perform schema design and performance tuning across SQL/NoSQL datastores.
  • Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts (diagrams, process/sequence flows, specifications); provide guidance to cross‑functional delivery teams.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelor’s in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Proactive, detail‑oriented collaborator in agile, cross‑functional environments.

title: IT PMO
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.


Sobre a vaga

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas, Economia ou áreas relacionadas
  • Boa experiência em PMO, gestão financeira ou funções de controle financeiro de projetos
  • Experiência com gestão de orçamento, previsão financeira e análise de realizado vs. orçado
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos, faturamento, pedidos de compra (PO) e controle de despesas
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos e interação com stakeholders executivos (ex.: CIO, diretores, chefes de departamento)
  • Experiência com governança de projetos ou gestão de portfólio de projetos, preferencialmente em ambientes de TI
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e organizacionais
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com diferentes áreas
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado



O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
