title: Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration .


In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate resilient OT-IT data pipelines across SCADA/MES and enterprise systems. Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), model/govern industrial data, and deliver secure batch and streaming integrations on prem and in the cloud.

  • End to end pipelines: Design, implement, and operate batch/streaming flows from SCADA, MES, and Historians to cloud/enterprise (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is plus.
  • UNS & modeling: Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), data modeling, and metadata management; ensure data quality, lineage, and governance.
  • Industrial integration: Connect (Ignition, HighByte, HiveMQ advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/consume RESTful APIs and connectors for SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Design schemas and tune performance across SQL and NoSQL stores.
  • Security & reliability: implement authN/authZ best practices; Design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Dev practices: use Git/GitHub (branching, reviews, releases) and create clear architecture diagrams, process flows, and specifications.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is a plus.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving with structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration .


In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate resilient OT-IT data pipelines across SCADA/MES and enterprise systems. Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), model/govern industrial data, and deliver secure batch and streaming integrations on prem and in the cloud.

  • End to end pipelines: Design, implement, and operate batch/streaming flows from SCADA, MES, and Historians to cloud/enterprise (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is plus.
  • UNS & modeling: Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), data modeling, and metadata management; ensure data quality, lineage, and governance.
  • Industrial integration: Connect (Ignition, HighByte, HiveMQ advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/consume RESTful APIs and connectors for SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Design schemas and tune performance across SQL and NoSQL stores.
  • Security & reliability: implement authN/authZ best practices; Design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Dev practices: use Git/GitHub (branching, reviews, releases) and create clear architecture diagrams, process flows, and specifications.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is a plus.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving with structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.


Key responsibilities:


- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.


Requirements:


- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Cientista de Dados Sênior com experiência comprovada em projetos de IA aplicada, inglês avançado (no mínimo para compreensão de leitura e audição), capacidade de liderar projetos de forma independente e experiência no desenvolvimento e supervisão de atividades em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de IA (do pré-processamento de dados à implantação em produção).

Experiência desenvolvendo projetos com IA Generativa,

Experiência com projetos em ambiente de nuvem,

Habilidades de programação avançadas em Python, SQL e NoSQL

title: Java Programming Analyst
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend Sênior

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Backend para integrar nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores, com alto nível de complexidade e impacto. Se você gosta de construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e bem estruturadas, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java (versões 7 a 21)
  • Criar e evoluir APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot
  • Integrar sistemas por meio de mensageria (RabbitMQ)
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e MySQL)
  • Atuar em projetos de média e alta complexidade, garantindo qualidade e performance
  • Implementar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e observabilidade


Requisitos Técnicos

Linguagens e Frameworks:

  • Java (8 a 21) e manutenção em Java 7
  • Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security

Banco de Dados:

  • Oracle
  • MySQL

Mensageria:

  • RabbitMQ

DevOps e Infraestrutura:

  • Docker
  • Git

Observabilidade:

  • Elastic Stack (Kibana)
  • Grafana
  • Prometheus

Qualidade de Código:

  • Testes unitários com JUnit e Mockito
  • Análise estática com SonarQube

Arquitetura e Integração:

  • WSO2
  • Nomad
  • WebLogic


Formação

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificação Spring Professional
  • Certificações em Cloud/DevOps (AWS, Docker, etc.)
  • Certificações em Arquitetura ou Integração (WSO2, Microservices)


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Backend Developer (Python +Golang +GCP)/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Profile: Backend Developer (Python +Golang +GCP)

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil.


Job Description:


8+ years of software development experience , with 4–5+ years working with Golang and Python in backend systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Golang and Python .
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs following standard REST design principles.
  • Develop scalable solutions using microservices, SOA, and distributed architectures .
  • Apply object-oriented and functional programming paradigms in system design.
  • Implement and follow SOLID principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Design and architect scalable, highly available, and reliable systems .
  • Work with cloud platforms (GCP) to deploy and manage applications.
  • Build and manage cloud-native solutions using services like compute, storage, networking, and managed databases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions .
  • Identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in code and database queries.
  • Design and manage complex data models and persistent storage systems .
  • Take ownership of technical roadmaps and architecture decisions .
  • Monitor and maintain production systems , ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis .
  • Implement observability tools (logging, monitoring, tracing) for system visibility.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership and guidance .
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and frameworks .

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Golang and Python backend development
  • Expertise in REST API design and development
  • Experience with microservices and distributed architectures
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform)
  • Knowledge of cloud services (Compute Engine, GKE, Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns and SOLID principles
  • Experience with database design and complex data models
  • Ability to work independently and proactively
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with open-source software and dependency management
  • Knowledge of Object/Document databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Firestore, etc.)
  • Experience with caching and in-memory databases (Redis, Memcached)
  • Familiarity with asynchronous and multi-threaded programming
  • Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, SQS, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, GKE, EKS)
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager)

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior AWS
description:
Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (AWS)


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto na área de Dados, em um de nossos maiores clientes, com foco em Engenharia de Dados voltada a AWS , por meio de contrato PJ.


Perfil Técnico Esperado:

  • Experiência prática com data lakes, data mesh e serviços da AWS , incluindo Amazon Web Services (AWS Glue, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3).
  • Capacidade de desenvolver APIs e implementar soluções utilizando PySpark em ambientes como Databricks e EMR.
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de recursos e clusters na AWS.
  • Desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de pipelines de dados , incluindo arquitetura Lambda.
  • Estruturação e gestão de arquitetura de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e condução de sessões de transferência de conhecimento (KT) das soluções implementadas.
  • Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis como Scrum, Kanban e Lean.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações da AWS: Certified Data Engineer – Associate .


Escopo de Atuação:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados conforme demandas do projeto.
  • Estruturar e aprimorar a arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Garantir a documentação técnica das soluções entregues.
  • Realizar transferência de conhecimento das implementações realizadas à equipe interna, quando aplicável.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Korber Support/Dev Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide ongoing support for Körber WMS applications, including issue resolution, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime and business impact.
  • Perform regular system maintenance, upgrades, and patching activities.
  • Customize and extend Körber applications based on business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain scripts or custom code to enhance system functionality.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (business, IT, and operations) to support system improvements and enhancements.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Developer/Support Specialist working on Körber (HighJump) WMS solutions .
  • Strong hands-on experience with Körber suite products and configurations.
  • Experience in customization and extension of Körber applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages relevant to Körber environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good understanding of system maintenance, upgrades, and support processes.


Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced support environment.
  • Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) ChatBot WeChat — Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) ChatBot WeChat — Sênior

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior para liderar o design e a evolução de soluções conversacionais no ecossistema WeChat. Esse profissional atuará com alto grau de autonomia, participando de decisões arquiteturais e contribuindo diretamente para a evolução técnica da plataforma.


Responsabilidades

– Arquitetar e evoluir soluções de chatbot utilizando WeChat Official Accounts e Omnichat Official Accounts

– Projetar integrações robustas utilizando REST APIs, Webhooks e OAuth WeChat

– Definir e implementar estratégias de NLP com frameworks como Rasa, Dialogflow ou Microsoft Bot Framework

– Desenhar arquitetura de dados utilizando MySQL, MongoDB e Redis

– Implementar pipelines de mensageria com RabbitMQ ou Kafka

– Provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura em cloud (Tencent Cloud, AWS ou Alibaba Cloud)

– Containerizar e orquestrar serviços utilizando Docker e Kubernetes

– Integrar soluções de pagamento via WeChat Pay

– Atuar na mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores júnior e pleno


Requisitos

– Experiência com WeChat Official Accounts ou plataformas de mensageria similares

– Conhecimento em REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON e OAuth

– Experiência com Node.js, Java (Spring Boot) ou Python

– Experiência com bancos de dados MySQL ou MongoDB

– Experiência no desenvolvimento de integrações backend

– Vivência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e mensageria

– Experiência com ambientes cloud


Diferenciais

– Experiência com WeChat Mini Programs

– Conhecimento em frameworks de NLP (Microsoft Bot Framework, Rasa ou Dialogflow)

– Experiência com Redis

– Experiência com RabbitMQ ou Kafka

– Experiência com Tencent Cloud, AWS ou Alibaba Cloud

– Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes

– Experiência com WeChat Pay

title: Service Delivery Lead
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.

Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente!

Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Atuar como responsável executivo pelo Service Delivery do PC3 Managed Services na região AMER , garantindo excelência operacional, cumprimento de SLAs/KPIs, governança estruturada e relacionamento sólido com stakeholders estratégicos da SAP.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a gestão do serviço PC3 na região das Américas, com foco em estabilidade, qualidade e evolução contínua.
  • Monitorar e garantir o cumprimento de KPIs e SLAs contratuais , conduzindo planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato gerencial da SAP , incluindo stakeholders seniores.
  • Ser o ponto focal de escalonamento para situações críticas do serviço.
  • Conduzir reuniões periódicas de governança com a SAP e com os líderes operacionais locais.
  • Coordenar-se com os Service Delivery Managers centrais na Alemanha , assegurando alinhamento global.
  • Apoiar o crescimento do serviço , incluindo ramp-up de capacidade, estruturação de times e evolução de processos.
  • Elaborar e apresentar planos executivos de estabilização e evolução do serviço para a SAP.
  • Atuação regional sobre um time de aproximadamente 26 profissionais nas Américas (Brasil, Colômbia e Argentina), majoritariamente externos.
  • Estrutura matricial e global , com forte interação com times da Alemanha e SAP.
  • Alta exposição executiva, tanto interna quanto externa.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sênior/expert em Service Delivery, Managed Services ou ambientes SLA-based.
  • Histórico comprovado em gestão de serviços complexos e clientes estratégicos .
  • Experiência sólida em governança, KPIs, SLAs e gestão de escalonamentos .
  • Vivência em ambientes globais e multiculturais , com estruturas distribuídas.
  • Inglês fluente (idioma oficial de trabalho).
  • Experiência prévia com SAP, serviços cloud ou ecossistema SAP.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Forte postura executiva e maturidade profissional .
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e em contextos críticos .
  • Excelente comunicação executiva e poder de influência .
  • Tomada de decisão assertiva e orientação a resultados.
  • Alto senso de responsabilidade e ownership.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas operacionais em mensagens claras para executivos .


Regime de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Residentes no Brasil)

*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Ivanti ITSM Support
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.


Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Cientista de Dados III (Geoprocessamento)
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Atuar de forma especializada nas iniciativas da Diretoria de Marketing, sendo referência técnica/comportamental para a empresa e mercado, estando a frente no conhecimento das áreas temáticas de Inteligência de Mercado, produtos e portifólio, conforme orientação estratégica da Diretoria, visando monitorar, coletar, analisar e interpretar dados e informações de alto nível com o objetivo de identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Analisar dados estruturados e não estruturados para identificar padrões e insights;
  • Estruturar e preparar dados para análises mais precisas e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver, testar e implementar modelos analíticos e algoritmos complexos;
  • Aplicar estatística avançada para geração de insights e apoio à decisão;
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas para identificar oportunidades de negócio;
  • Minerar e explorar dados para otimização de produtos e processos;
  • Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações para suporte estratégico;
  • Trabalhar com Big Data, dados geoespaciais e modelos de Machine Learning;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e governança dos dados;
  • Apresentar resultados e insights de forma clara para tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
  • Estatística e Geoestatística;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
  • Conceitos de Map Reduce, Spark e HDFS;
  • Experiência em processamento de Big Data;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Fluxo de inovação;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em processamento de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de Marketing B2B;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para trabalhar com dados desestruturados;
  • Noções de cartografia e sensoriamento remoto;
  • Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
  • Ferramentas de Análise de Dados;
  • Algoritmo e modelos preditivos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Experiência em processamento de Big Data;
  • Processamento de dados, AI e Big Data em Cloud;
  • Aprendizado de Máquina (Machine Learning);
  • Conhecimento e compreensão avançada dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela VEGA.


Informações adicionais:

Por que escolher a VEGA?


Modelo de Trabalho Moderno:

  • Trabalho 100% Remoto ou Híbrido, se você estiver próximo à nossa sede (São José dos Campos) ou hubs (Lavras e Piracicaba).


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde: Sul América ou Unimed (conforme localidade).

title: Arquiteto(a) de Software
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Domínio em .NET Core versões 3, 6 e 8, atuando no desenvolvimento de serviços,

APIs e aplicações distribuídas com boas práticas de arquitetura e

programação.


o Conhecimentos em Node.js 16, envolvendo criação de serviços, APIs e

integrações, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas do ecossistema

JavaScript/TypeScript.

o Experiência com Angular versões 10, 14 e 18

envolvendo desenvolvimento de interfaces responsivas, componentização e

integração com APIs REST.

o Conhecimento intermediário em SQL Server e MongoDB, incluindo

modelagem, consultas, otimização básica e manipulação de dados em

ambientes relacionais e NoSQL.

o Familiaridade com ferramentas e frameworks aceleradores de

desenvolvimento apoiados por IA, como Cursor, RooCode e BMAD,

código.

- .NET Core

- Node.js

- Angular

- SQL Server

- MongoDB

title: Analista fiscal
description:
Analista Fiscal


A Linus é uma marca que tem como propósito tornar o bem-estar um estilo de vida , por meio de escolhas práticas e conscientes. Por isso, se você quer fazer parte de um amanhã mais sustentável - ambiental, social e financeiramente - questionando o status-quo de maneira colaborativa e ética, esta vaga é para você.


sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Analista Fiscal para atuar na operação do dia a dia, garantindo a correta apuração de tributos e consistência fiscal das operações. A posição terá forte interface com logística, faturamento e contabilidade, com foco em garantir que as operações estejam corretas no ERP e nas notas fiscais.


o que você vai fazer


  • Apuração de ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL, PIS e COFINS
  • Validação de notas fiscais de entrada e saída
  • Análise de CFOP e operações interestaduais
  • Suporte a operações de ecommerce e marketplaces
  • Conciliação de estoque fiscal vs físico
  • Validação e ajustes de regras fiscais no ERP (Omie, Tiny ou similar)
  • Interface com contabilidade e áreas internas


do que você precisa


  • Experiência com tributos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS)
  • Experiência com ERP
  • Excel intermediário
  • (diferencial) Experiência em varejo ou ecommerce
  • (diferencial) Experiência com marketplaces
  • (diferencial) Experiência com parametrização fiscal em ERP


o que oferecemos:


  • Ambiente leve, criativo e de alta performance
  • Muita oportunidade de crescimento e autonomia
  • Localização acessível, próxima ao metrô
  • Vale-refeição
  • Auxílio Home Office (modelo híbrido)
  • Plano de saúde
  • Totalpass
  • Subsídio para aulas de inglês


onde estamos


Próximo à estacão Fradique Coutinho do metrô

Pinheiros - São Paulo - SP


Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Nos processos seletivos da Linus, não há

qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social ou raça.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.

title: Software LLM trainers
description:
Job Title: Software LLM trainers

  • Location: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Contract
  • Duration: 5 Weeks
  • Open Positions: 50+
  • Work Hours: 8 hours/day (4 hours PST overlap mandatory)
  • Note: Candidates must have their own working machine (no system will be provided)

About the Role

  • Work on evaluating and improving outputs generated by Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Involves a mix of technical understanding, analysis, and structured annotation
  • Requires ability to work with AI systems, workflows, and developer tools

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting
  • Ability to break down complex problems into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tools
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, and terminal-based automation
  • Experience with browser automation or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs

title: Automations Engineer
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.


You can learn more about our platform and .


The Role

We are hiring an Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining complex automation processes that connect our core systems, structure internal data, and support communication with investors and founders. You will play a key role in building scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency and ensure reliable information flow across our platform.


Responsibilities

  • Design and manage multi-step automation workflows using n8n to support internal operations
  • Build systems that connect and synchronize data across Supabase, Attio, and Airtable
  • Develop structured workflows that process operational data, generate internal reports, and support activity tracking
  • Implement AI-supported workflows that process unstructured inputs into structured outputs
  • Ensure reliability across workflows through testing, monitoring, and error-handling logic
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate internal processes and improve operational efficiency


Profile

  • 2–4 years experience in automation engineering, workflow architecture, or low-code development
  • Strong experience building workflows in n8n or similar platforms (Make, Zapier, Retool, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.
  • Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Progress Rail’s data science team is looking for a motivated and talented Data Scientist who will primarily focus on developing Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence based data models for condition-based monitoring of its assets. In this role, the candidate will contribute to the design, development and deployment of world class rail products and services vital to our customer’s needs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced self-starter, strong attention to details, with excellent written and verbal skills. Enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced, environment and is willing to take on roles outside of comfort zone. Technical aptitude and being well versed in Data Science tools and processes is a must. The role will work closely with the different engineering teams.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Key Job Elements

  • Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of software systems and applications.
  • Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
  • Apply Machine Learning and other advanced analytical techniques to develop models for condition-based monitoring of locomotive systems.
  • Apply Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) to support text mining, document summarization and others.
  • Understand the business needs and develop data-based solutions.
  • Doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner.
  • Supporting field reported issue resolution through data analysis.
  • System integration of Machine Learning models.


Education Requirements


  • B.S, M.S, or PhD degree in quantitative discipline such as data science, data analytics, computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or other related degree.


Technical Skill

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, and relational database systems.

• Hands-on experience across the entire data science project lifecycle , including data acquisition, data cleaning, data engineering, feature scaling, feature engineering, model testing, validation, and data visualization.

• Practical application of machine learning algorithms, such as regression models, XGBoost, neural networks, and others.

• Development of LLM‑based solutions for document search and summarization using RAG architecture.

• Strong applied statistics skills , including distributions, statistical tests, regression techniques, and related analyses.

• Experience with AWS cloud services , including container services, S3, and additional relevant components.

• Advanced data visualization capabilities , using tools such as Power BI and Python Matplotlib to build clear, interactive, and actionable dashboards and reports.

• Strong business acumen , with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to both technical and non‑technical audiences.


Desirable:

• Expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and text mining.

• Work experience in an operations control center or in railway operations planning.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Creativity : Proposing innovative and original solutions in order to add value to processes and increase the company's competitiveness.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Analytical Ability: The ability to analyze data and information, regardless of their the relationship between them, to enable logical decision-making, based on data.


Additional Information:

The selection process will be carried out through CV analysis, interviews, a technical test and professional profile mapping (DISC).


What we are offering for this position:

- CLT contract

- Health insurance for you and your dependents

- Dental plan for you and your dependents

- Meal vouchers

- Food voucher

- Life insurance

- Application for discounts at gyms

- Application for discounts on medicines in pharmacies

- PLR - Profit Sharing

- Private pension plan

- Continuing education allowance

- Extended maternity and paternity leave

title: Analista Hubspot
description:
A Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) é líder global em serviços de TI, consultoria & soluções de negócios com uma grande rede de centros de inovação & entrega.

Fomos reconhecidos como um Global Top Employer e nossa capacidade de fornecer carreiras holísticas de longo prazo baseadas em aprendizado contínuo impulsionado por nosso ecossistema de aprendizagem digital nos ajuda a desenvolver os melhores talentos!

E convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Analista HubSpot para atuar na administração, evolução e sustentação de todo o ecossistema HubSpot — incluindo CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub e/ou Operations Hub.Se você domina CRM, automações inteligentes e melhoria contínua de processos, esta vaga pode ser perfeita para você! O profissional será peça-chave entre Marketing, Vendas, Customer Success/Atendimento e TI, garantindo que o HubSpot funcione de forma estratégica e eficiente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão e Administração do HubSpot
  • Configurar e administrar usuários, permissões, equipes e propriedades.
  • Estruturar e manter pipelines de vendas e atendimento com SLAs e regras bem definidas.
  • Criar e garantir boas práticas, governança e padronização do uso do CRM.

Automação e Processos:

  • Criar workflows, regras de roteamento e automações inteligentes.
  • Implementar lead scoring, nutrição de leads e handoff entre Marketing e Vendas.
  • Automatizar comunicações e processos de pós-venda/CS.

Dados e Performance:

  • Assegurar qualidade de dados, deduplicação e normalizações.
  • Monitorar indicadores de funil e produtividade das equipes.
  • Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

Relatórios e Inteligência:

  • Construir dashboards e relatórios para Marketing, Vendas e liderança.
  • Acompanhar métricas como CAC, MQL/SQL, conversões, receita por canal e churn/retention.
  • Criar visões executivas recorrentes para suporte à gestão.

Integrações e Evolução da Plataforma:

  • Apoiar integrações com ferramentas como Microsoft 365, Salesforce, RD Station, WhatsApp, telefonia, ERPs e outras.
  • Colaborar com TI/Engenharia em integrações via API e Webhooks.
  • Documentar processos, apoiar testes e releases.

Treinamento e Suporte:

  • Treinar usuários, criar playbooks e dar suporte de 1º/2º nível.
  • Estimular a adoção e padronização dos processos no CRM.

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência prática com HubSpot (CRM + ao menos 1 Hub).
  • Vivência em criação de workflows, listas, pipelines e propriedades.
  • Conhecimento de processos de funil (Marketing, Vendas ou CS).
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade com dashboards e métricas.
  • Excelente comunicação e trabalho colaborativo.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações HubSpot (Admin, Marketing, Sales, Reporting, Operations).
  • Experiência com Operations Hub e governança de dados.
  • Noções de integrações via API, Webhooks, Zapier/Make.
  • Conhecimento de lead scoring, attribution, lifecycle stages e ABM.
  • Experiência com GA4, Power BI/Looker, telefonia/WhatsApp e plataformas de mídia.

Modelo de contratação:

  • CLT Full + Benefícios

Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de descontos com Universidades e escolas de idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

Operamos em escala global, com diversas bases de talentos representando 156 nacionalidades, em 55 países. Na Tata Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, sempre trabalhamos pela equidade. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Diversidade de experiências e Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas vagas são trabalhadas com esses princípios.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: AWS AI/ML Architect (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar soluções utilizando serviços da AWS para IA generativa, como Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker.
  • Definir padrões de orquestração de agentes, integração com APIs e workflows corporativos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar AI Agents capazes de executar tarefas, consultas e automações complexas.
  • Construir pipelines de RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) para acesso a dados corporativos.
  • Integrar agentes com sistemas bancários, APIs internas e plataformas digitais.
  • Implementar memória de agentes, ferramentas (tools) e mecanismos de reasoning.
  • Aplicar AI Agents para acelerar desenvolvimento e modernização de aplicações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Smart Engineering e AI-assisted development.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos de segurança, compliance e governança de dados do setor financeiro.
  • Definir modelos de observabilidade e métricas de performance para agentes de IA.
  • Monitorar qualidade de respostas, latência e custo de inferência.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Agents Builder / desenvolvimento de AI Agents
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Cloud (AWS)
  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock e Amazon SageMaker
  • Domínio em RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • conhecimento em MLOps
  • conhecimento em Spring Boot / Java
  • Integração com APIs REST
  • Orquestração de agentes e workflows
  • Implementação de memória, tools e reasoning em agentes de IA
  • Integração com sistemas corporativos e plataformas digitais

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency
